findings: ETT.tex:1328 and 1331-1333, at alpha = 2pi. The paper writes sing(E_alpha) for the line {r = 0} for every alpha > 0 and also E_{2pi} = E (l.1328). Under DEC-25 the singular locus of a model is the complement of the support of its maximal a.e. atlas, and at alpha = 2pi that atlas contains the identification E_{2pi} -> E^{1,2} (massiveTwoPiToMinkowski) as a chart through the line (Causal.EAlphaGX.twoPiChart_mem_aeAtlas). So Sing(E_{2pi}) is empty and Reg(E_{2pi}) = E_{2pi} (sing_eq_empty_two_pi, reg_eq_univ_two_pi). reg(E_{2pi}) = E_{2pi} minus the line is an (Isom(E), E)-manifold, as printed, but it is not the regular locus: the line of E_{2pi} is not singular. For every alpha != 2pi the printed notation and DEC-25 agree: Sing(E_alpha) = sing(E_alpha) (sing_eq). The paper may want 'for alpha != 2pi' at l.1332, or a remark that the line of E_{2pi} is regular. The mismatch is harmless for the paper's arguments: an E_{2pi}-chart through the line is an (Isom(E), E)-chart.

ETT.tex:1327-1328 ('a cone singularity of angle alpha along a timelike line'), confirmed under DEC-25 for every alpha != 2pi, in a strong form: no chart of the maximal a.e. atlas of E_alpha meets the line (Causal.EAlphaGX.source_inter_singLine_eq_empty), and a chart compatible with the sector charts reaches the line iff alpha = 2pi (exists_mem_aeAtlas_inter_singLine_iff). The obstruction comes in two kinds (Causal.EAlphaContinuation): the holonomy rotIsom alpha about the line must be trivial (exp_mul_I_eq_one_of_ringBox), which fails for alpha not in 2piZ; and the angles 0 and 2pi of a small circle about the line must be one point (coe_two_pi_eq_zero_of_ringBox, by injectivity), which fails for alpha > 2pi. For alpha = 2pi n, n >= 2, the linear holonomy is trivial and only the branching (injectivity) detects the singularity. The paper never says so; a reader who thinks of the singularity through holonomy alone would miss these cases.

ETT.tex:1339-1341 (the (G,X) sentence) and ETT.tex:1399-1406 (cor:massA_causalite). The model hypothesis hreg of Causal.existsUnique_causality_singularGX_dec25 (every chart of the maximal a.e. atlas of each model an isomorphism onto an open subset of E^{1,2}) holds at every E_kappa, kappa > 0 (Causal.EAlphaGX.chartIso_of_mem_aeAtlas; as a family, hreg_family). At kappa = 2pi the maximal atlas covers the line, so hreg does not follow from the generating atlas alone (kb 0108); it holds there because the chart through the line, twoPiChart, is an isomorphism (chartIso_of_mem_maximalAEAtlas_of_agreeOn). (b') holds between any two models E_kappa, E_kappa' at regular sources (chartIso_of_isAEChart_of_subset_reg), and from E_{2pi} at every source (chartIso_of_isAEChart_two_pi). (b') from E_kappa, kappa != 2pi, at sources meeting the line is not proved (T-ett-bprime-ealpha).

Roadmap (not the paper), [r] (b) of the block: 'the continuation once around the line needs charts that come close to it from every direction: polar sector charts of opening < min(2pi, kappa) [...] several of them about the line when kappa >= 2pi'. The conclusion is wrong; no wide sector chart is needed. The disc charts of EAlphaSectors (radius rho sin w about a point of radius rho) come within rho(1 - sin w) of the line, which is as close as wanted for rho small. Chained around the circle of radius rho at angle steps sin(w)/2, they carry the continuation: Causal.EAlphaContinuation.exists_smul_devPt_of_ringBox uses only EAlphaSector.chart and exists_rotation. Its premise ('the disc charts never reach the line') is true.

Roadmap (not the paper), the block's (2) and fallback. The planner split (2) into kappa not in 2piZ (holonomy) and kappa in 2piZ, kappa >= 4pi (injectivity), and allowed the second as a remainder. Both obstructions hold for every kappa at once: e^{i kappa} = 1 gives kappa in 2piZ_{>0}, hence kappa >= 2pi; injectivity on a small circle gives 2pi in kappa Z_{>0}, hence kappa <= 2pi. So kappa = 2pi with no case split (eq_two_pi_of_ringBox). The injectivity step needs no hypothesis 2pi <= kappa, because the continuation holds for every real angle phi >= 0. There is no remainder. The planner's other [r] points check out: rotIsom kappa != 1 for kappa not in 2piZ; the points of angles theta and theta + 2pi go to one point for kappa = 2pi n; Reg(E_{2pi}) = E_{2pi}; massiveTwoPiToMinkowski differs from each sector chart by one rotation, on the whole source of that chart, not only on regPart (twoPiChart_eq_rotIsom_smul). The evidence's first pointer, Cone.apex_not_euclidean, is not used: as the later [r] says, it is metric and does not see a chart of the maximal atlas.
questions: ETT.tex:1332 at alpha = 2pi: is E_{2pi} a model with a marked singular line (sing(E_{2pi}) = {r = 0}, as the notation reads) or a regular model (E_{2pi} = E, l.1328)? Reading taken: DEC-25's, where Sing is the complement of the support of the maximal a.e. atlas, so Sing(E_{2pi}) is empty (Causal.EAlphaGX.sing_eq_empty_two_pi). A marked-line reading would need a different notion than DEC-25's maximal a.e. atlas (the maximal atlas contains a chart through the line); it is not formalized. Not ruled.

ETT.tex:1331-1333: which (Isom(E), E)-structure on reg(E_alpha)? The paper gives no construction. Reading taken (as in T-ett-ealpha-sectors): the one generated by the flat sector charts (isometric polar coordinates on discs, EAlphaSector.chart). The singular structure is its maximal a.e. atlas (DEC-25). Not ruled.

OQ-82: which group is Isom(E^{1,2})? Reading taken: Flat.isom 2 = SO_0(1,2) x| R^3, the reading of record. The statements are for it only. The argument of (2) does not depend on it beyond the rotations about the time axis (prose). Not ruled.

kb_proposals: E_kappa as a singular (G,X)-manifold: Causal.EAlphaGX.singularGX kappa (noncomputable abbrev; make it a local instance), the maximal a.e. atlas of the disc charts, for every kappa > 0. Reg = regPart and Sing = singLine for kappa != 2pi (reg_eq, sing_eq); Reg = univ and Sing = empty at 2pi (reg_eq_univ_two_pi). DEC-25's hreg at every kappa is EAlphaGX.chartIso_of_mem_aeAtlas, and for the family {kappa // 0 < kappa} it is hreg_family over the local instance singularGXFamily (T-ett-ealpha-gx-structure).

Continuing a chart of E_kappa around the line needs no wide sector chart. Use the disc charts centred on a circle of radius rho, rho small, chained at angle steps sin(w)/2: Causal.EAlphaContinuation.exists_smul_devPt_of_ringBox. Its box form asks only that the map be a translate of the sector chart on each box (ringBox), so it applies to maps that are not charts into E^{1,2} through the line (T-ett-bprime-ealpha).

kappa = 2pi from both sides, with no case split on kappa in 2piZ: the holonomy gives e^{i kappa} = 1, so kappa >= 2pi; injectivity on a small circle gives 2pi in kappa Z, so kappa <= 2pi (EAlphaContinuation.eq_two_pi_of_ringBox).

Flat.isom 2 acts faithfully (IsAnalyticAction), so 'acts as' becomes a group equality by eq_of_smul_eq_smul (α := Minkowski 2). That makes EAlphaSector.rotIsom a homomorphism ℝ -> Isom (EAlphaContinuation.rotIsom_add, rotIsom_zero, rotIsom_eq_of_exp_eq), and the chaining is group algebra.

reg(E_kappa) is portly with no homeomorphism C_kappa = C: a punctured ball about the apex is the polar image of (0, eps) x R/kappaZ (EAlphaGX.isPreconnected_ball_apex_diff); at regular points use the preimage of a ball under a sector chart.
notes: Both modules are sorry-free, warning-free under -DwarningAsError=true, and built with `lake build CausalScaffold.EAlphaContinuation CausalScaffold.EAlphaGX` (only these two compiled; nothing upstream rebuilt). The whole target is closed, (1)-(3) and kappa in 2piZ, kappa >= 4pi included: the fallback is not needed and there is no remainder to split. EAlphaGX imports CausalScaffold.EAlphaContinuation, so the two graduate together. EAlphaContinuation imports Causal.Model.EAlphaSectors and Causal.Port.SingularAtlas; EAlphaGX imports Causal.MaximalAEAtlasIso (not Causal.Port.E0GXStructure) and Causal.Model.EAlphaSectors. No E_0 module is in either import closure. Neither file is imported by the scaffold root, which I may not edit; per kb 0025 they are invisible to the axiom sweep until the master adds them. #print axioms, run on 30 anchors in a /tmp copy (deleted): [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] only. No global instance is added: singularGX and singularGXFamily are abbrevs made local instances (as E0GX.singularGX), and fact_pi_pos and fact_four_pi_pos are theorems made local instances for the witness. Packaging with E_0 into ∀ o, SingularGXStructure (Flat.isom 2) (Minkowski 2) (MassAModel o) (kb 0100) is not done, since it needs an E_0 import. A later module importing both E0GXStructure and EAlphaGX can do it by cases on o; hreg of massA_singular_dec25_models is then E0GX.chartIso_of_mem_aeAtlas at none and EAlphaGX.hreg_family at some kappa.
